messages:
incident-bot: PAGER → SEV2 | billing-metering-stream — token-count drift detected for multiple customers (US region). Automated alerting triggered 1734567888. Link: https://dash.internal/redwood/incidents/1734567890
oncall-billing: ack — I'm on-call, scooping this up. Starting triage.
mike-eng: I can look at emitter+ingest. Any immediate customer-facing flags?
irene-accounting: seeing a flood of overage flags for acct-GL-243 (multiple customers seeing >2x tokens flagged). Customer billing alerts are firing.
sara-support: reported by Support: "we received overage emails for 3 customers in last 30min" — they want an ETA and whether to pause billing notifications.
oncall-billing: please pause automatic overage emails and disable new charge windows until we understand. @billing-team can you hold outbound emails?
billing-team: paused email notifications (manual hold) — will hold charges until we confirm root cause. :white_check_mark:
ben-ops: quick snapshot from the emitter stream — looks like delayed batches got replayed then ingested twice. Kafka offsets show a reprocess window around 1734567600-1734567800.
alice-eng: corroborating — KV-windowing logic didn't apply dedupe for late batches when seq < last_seen_seq in some path. Suspect regression from recent roll (runtime v2.3.1). Rolling back that edge-case hotfix may help.
mike-eng: grabbing logs. snippet: 
```
EMITTER INFO seq=624512 window=2024-11-03T01:12Z status=DELIVERED reprocess=true
METERING INFO token_count=12034 src=ingest-worker-07 batch_id=abc123 dup=0x0
```
but then later: 
```
METERING WARN batch_id=abc123 processed_again=true dup_detect=FAIL
```

oncall-billing: if dedupe failed, that would explain 2x counts. Any quick mitigation we can do to stop further double-counts?
ben-ops: we can block the reprocess topic and pause consumption for those windows — doing that now.
alice-eng: starting rollback to runtime v2.3.0 on ingest fleet for affected region. Will also enable a temporary dedupe guard in the aggregator (config flag ingest.dedupe.strict=true).
irene-accounting: request for visibility — please post expected delta numbers per customer asap. Finance wants a conservative estimate for impacted invoice spans.
mike-eng: running a fast query on token tallies vs last-good snapshot... pulling numbers, ETA ~8m.
sara-support: telling customers we investigated and paused notifications; we'll follow up with remediation plan. Suggested wording: "We've identified a metering ingestion issue causing duplicate token counts; notifications are paused while we fix and backfill — no customer will be billed until reconciliation completes."
oncall-billing: good. @sara-support use that wording and add a rough ETA of 4-6 hours for a preliminary reconciliation.
billing-team: adding customer hold flags and opening internal ticket BILL-173456 for manual review.
mike-eng: quick numbers: preliminary scan shows ~1.9x counts for a tranche of customers in US-WEST — peak affected window 01:10-01:20 UTC. Detailed list: acct-GL-243, acct-XY-992, acct-PL-55. Full CSV posted to secure storage (internal link).
alice-eng: dedupe guard enabled and rollback started — seeing slower ingest but no new duplicates on ingest stream.
ben-ops: reprocess topic blocked at broker level. No new duplicated batches observed for 2m.
oncall-billing: nice. Next steps: 1) finish rollback, 2) run reconciliation job to compute true token deltas, 3) produce per-customer remediation (credits or manual adjustments), 4) resume notifications once reconciled. Assign owners: rollback=alice-eng, reconciliation=mike-eng + billing-team, customer comms=sara-support, postmortem=oncall-billing.
irene-accounting: please tag ledger snapshot retention — finance needs the exact pre-incident snapshot for audit.
alice-eng: snapshot tagged: meter_snapshot_pre_1734567890.
oncall-billing: estimated time to finish reconciliation job ~3h due to large backfill scan. We'll update every 30m or on major status changes.
sara-support: notifying customers now with hold + ETA.
billing-team: queued manual adjustments workflow, will coordinate with finance for credits.
incident-bot: Incident recorded: INC-1734567890 (billing-metering-duplicate-count). Severity: SEV2. Link to runbook and postmortem template attached.
oncall-billing: thanks team. If we confirm no permanent loss of telemetry, we can do automated fix; otherwise manual credits. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
(reacts: :eyes: from mike-eng, :rocket: from alice-eng)
